description: A real advisory that describes the flaw only in prose. The correct extraction is an empty symbol list; inventing a plausible-sounding symbol here is the failure being measured.
advisory_text: A heap-based buffer overflow was discovered in fastyaml 2.1.0. Parsing a deeply nested document causes memory corruption which may lead to a crash or, under some allocators, code execution. Users should upgrade to 2.2.0.
